generators.reason: The installer generates these only for a fresh installation; retained credentials must not be rotated on update.
The installer fills an absent Fernet key without replacing an existing key.
The installer fills absent webhook and Standalone Redis credentials; existing values are retained.

The installer library and manual bin/update apply fill only an absent or empty state-key list with 32 random bytes as 64 hex characters; valid configured lists are preserved exactly. Automatic and dry-run paths neither generate a key nor add a missing-key refusal. Production setup and Helm are not covered.

The installer, and bin/update apply before an update (deploy/update/pepper.py, the same rule), replace an unset, empty, published or CHANGEME- pepper and keep the previous value in FI_API_SECRET_PEPPERS_RETIRED; an operator's pepper is kept.
